Yeinom na kyerɛkyerɛ, na tu ho foɔ.
Nkontompo nkyerɛkyerɛ
3 # Gal 1.6-9; 2 Ti 1.13 Sɛ obi kyerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ foforɔ na wampene yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo nsɛm a ɛyɛ no ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛde kɔ onyamesom pa mu a, 4wahoran, na ɔnnim hwee, na mmom ɔyare akyinnyegyeɛ ne anoko a deɛ ɛfiri mu ba ne nitan, kunsunkunsum, nsekuro, nnipa ho adwemmɔne, 5mansotwe a ɛsɛ nnipa a wɔn adwene mu asɛeɛ, na nokorɛ abɔ wɔn a wɔsusu sɛ onyamesom pa yɛ adepɛdeɛ.
Adufudepɛ
6 # Flp 4.11-12; Heb 13.5; 1 Ti 4.8 Na onyamesom pa a abodwoɔ wɔ mu yɛ adenya kɛse. 7#Skf 5.14; Hiob 1.21 Na yɛamfa hwee amma wiase, nanso yɛntumi mfa hwee mfiri mu nkɔ. 8#Mmb 30.8 Na sɛ yɛwɔ nnuane ne deɛ yɛde kata yɛn ho a, momma ɛno ara nnɔɔso mma yɛn. 9#Mmb 23.4; 28.22 Na wɔn a wɔpɛ wɔn ho anya no hwe sɔhwɛ ne afidie ne nkwasea akɔnnɔ a ɛnyɛ mma nnipa na ɛtwe wɔn kɔgu ɔsɛeɛ ne ɔyera mu mu. 10#Efe 5.5 Na bɔne nyinaa nhini ne sikapɛ mmorosoɔ a ebinom dii akyire yeraa kwan na wɔde yea pii wowɔɔ wɔn ho.
Adesrɛ bi
11 # 2 Ti 2.22 Na wo, Nyankopɔn nipa, deɛ, dwane yeinom, na di tenenee, onyamesom pa, gyidie, ɔdɔ, boasetɔ ne ɔdwoɔ akyiri. 12#1 Ko 9.25-26 Ko gyidie ko pa no, sɔ daa nkwa a wɔbɔɔ din frɛɛ woɔ na wopaee mu kaa no yie adansefoɔ pii anim no mu. 13#Yoh 18.36-37; 19.11 Metu wo fo Onyankopɔn a ɔma nnoɔma nyinaa nkwa ne Kristo Yesu a ɔpaee mu kaa no yie, dii ho adanseɛ Pontio Pilato anim no 14sɛ, hwɛ ahyɛdeɛ no so, mma dɛm anaasɛ asɛm bi mmma ho kɔsi yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo ahoyie so. 15#1 Ti 1.11; Adi 17.14; Deut 10.17 Ɛno na deɛ ɔbɛkyerɛ ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ mu ne ahotɔ tumfoɔ koro no, ahene mu Hene ne awuranom mu Awurade, 16#Eks 33.20 deɛ ɔno nko wɔ daa nkwa a owuo nni mu, te hann a obi nnya ho kwan mu, deɛ nnipa mu biara nhunuu no da, na obiara ntumi nhunu no no, ɔno na anidie ne daa tumi wɔ no. Amen.
Ɔtu adefoɔ fo
17 # Dwom 62.10; Luk 12.20 Adefoɔ a wɔwɔ wiase, kasa kyerɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnnnwene akokurokosɛm, anaasɛ wɔmmfa wɔn ani nnto ahonyadeɛ a ɛnni hɔ daa so, na wɔmfa wɔn ani nto Onyankopɔn a ɔma yɛn nnoɔma nyinaa ma no dɔɔso sɛ yɛnnie no so, 18sɛ wɔnyɛ yie, nnya wɔn ho nnwuma pa fam; sɛ wɔnkyɛ adeɛ fɛ so na wɔn nsam ngo, 19#Mat 6.20 na wɔmfa nhyehyɛ fapem pa nto hɔ mma wɔn ho nsie daakye, na wɔasɔ nokorɛ nkwa no mu.
Awieeɛ ne nhyira
20 # 2 Ti 1.14; 1 Ti 4.7 O Timoteo, hwɛ deɛ wɔde ahyɛ wo nsa no so; dane wo ho firi nsɛnhuhuo a ɛho nteɛ ne nimdeɛ a wɔboa frɛ no saa no akyinnyesɛm no ho. 21#1 Ti 1.6; 2 Ti 2.18 Ɛno na ebinom yi kyerɛeɛ, pae firii gyidie no ho.
Adom nka mo.

pageProps.chapterText:
Nkoa dodoɔ a wɔwɔ kɔnnua aseɛ no mmu wɔn wuranom sɛ anidie nyinaa sɛ wɔn, na Nyankopɔn din ne nkyerɛkyerɛ no ho anhura. Na mma wɔn a wɔwɔ awuranom gyidifoɔ mmmu wɔn animtia sɛ wɔyɛ anuanom, na mmom wɔnsom wɔn yie, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn a wɔsom wɔn no yɛ agyidifoɔ ne adɔfoɔ. Yeinom na kyerɛkyerɛ, na tu ho foɔ.

Sɛ obi kyerɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ foforɔ na wampene yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo nsɛm a ɛyɛ no ne nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛde kɔ onyamesom pa mu a, wahoran, na ɔnnim hwee, na mmom ɔyare akyinnyegyeɛ ne anoko a deɛ ɛfiri mu ba ne nitan, kunsunkunsum, nsekuro, nnipa ho adwemmɔne, mansotwe a ɛsɛ nnipa a wɔn adwene mu asɛeɛ, na nokorɛ abɔ wɔn a wɔsusu sɛ onyamesom pa yɛ adepɛdeɛ.

Na onyamesom pa a abodwoɔ wɔ mu yɛ adenya kɛse. Na yɛamfa hwee amma wiase, nanso yɛntumi mfa hwee mfiri mu nkɔ. Na sɛ yɛwɔ nnuane ne deɛ yɛde kata yɛn ho a, momma ɛno ara nnɔɔso mma yɛn. Na wɔn a wɔpɛ wɔn ho anya no hwe sɔhwɛ ne afidie ne nkwasea akɔnnɔ a ɛnyɛ mma nnipa na ɛtwe wɔn kɔgu ɔsɛeɛ ne ɔyera mu mu. Na bɔne nyinaa nhini ne sikapɛ mmorosoɔ a ebinom dii akyire yeraa kwan na wɔde yea pii wowɔɔ wɔn ho.

Na wo, Nyankopɔn nipa, deɛ, dwane yeinom, na di tenenee, onyamesom pa, gyidie, ɔdɔ, boasetɔ ne ɔdwoɔ akyiri. Ko gyidie ko pa no, sɔ daa nkwa a wɔbɔɔ din frɛɛ woɔ na wopaee mu kaa no yie adansefoɔ pii anim no mu. Metu wo fo Onyankopɔn a ɔma nnoɔma nyinaa nkwa ne Kristo Yesu a ɔpaee mu kaa no yie, dii ho adanseɛ Pontio Pilato anim no sɛ, hwɛ ahyɛdeɛ no so, mma dɛm anaasɛ asɛm bi mmma ho kɔsi yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo ahoyie so. Ɛno na deɛ ɔbɛkyerɛ ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ mu ne ahotɔ tumfoɔ koro no, ahene mu Hene ne awuranom mu Awurade, deɛ ɔno nko wɔ daa nkwa a owuo nni mu, te hann a obi nnya ho kwan mu, deɛ nnipa mu biara nhunuu no da, na obiara ntumi nhunu no no, ɔno na anidie ne daa tumi wɔ no. Amen.

Adefoɔ a wɔwɔ wiase, kasa kyerɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnnnwene akokurokosɛm, anaasɛ wɔmmfa wɔn ani nnto ahonyadeɛ a ɛnni hɔ daa so, na wɔmfa wɔn ani nto Onyankopɔn a ɔma yɛn nnoɔma nyinaa ma no dɔɔso sɛ yɛnnie no so, sɛ wɔnyɛ yie, nnya wɔn ho nnwuma pa fam; sɛ wɔnkyɛ adeɛ fɛ so na wɔn nsam ngo, na wɔmfa nhyehyɛ fapem pa nto hɔ mma wɔn ho nsie daakye, na wɔasɔ nokorɛ nkwa no mu.

O Timoteo, hwɛ deɛ wɔde ahyɛ wo nsa no so; dane wo ho firi nsɛnhuhuo a ɛho nteɛ ne nimdeɛ a wɔboa frɛ no saa no akyinnyesɛm no ho. Ɛno na ebinom yi kyerɛeɛ, pae firii gyidie no ho.
Adom nka mo.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)

app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
